_doc: Choice event cards. Text is placeholder copy written fresh for M1; the engine fills in each choice's effect line with live numbers. Final card writing is M3.

dew.title: Heavy dew
dew.text: The brush is soaked to the shoulder. Wet clothes all day, or a late start.

horseFall.title: A horse falls under its load
horseFall.text: A pack horse has gone down on the track and has to be unloaded and got up again.

horseExhausted.title: A horse is spent
horseExhausted.text: One of the horses can barely stand under its pack.

dryCamp.title: Dry camp
dryCamp.text: No water on the ridge tonight.

choices.fetch: Send two men down the gully

bowel.title: Bowel complaint
bowel.text: Salt meat and bad water are telling on him.

choices.hunt: Send a hunter for fresh meat

hunterStrays.title: A hunter is missing
hunterStrays.text: He followed a kangaroo off the ridge and has not come back.

dogsRaceOff.title: The dogs race off in the dark
dogsRaceOff.text: The dogs tore off into the scrub, barking. The men took it for someone out there; nobody saw anyone.

brood.title: The men brood
brood.text: A day without work gives the men time to count what is left.

refusal.title: The men will not go on
refusal.text: The servants say they have had enough of the ridges.
